content.text: I need to change IP from company_owns to university ownership, and adjust publication terms to allow academic publication.

{"action":"propose","sheet":{"engagement":"contract_research","scope":"Identify the dominant oxidation pathway(s) in Zlatna Njiva cold-pressed pumpkin seed oil (enzymatic, photo-oxidative, trace-metal-catalysed); conduct fatty acid profile, tocopherol content, peroxide value kinetics, and residual headspace oxygen analysis; deliver actionable process recommendations implementable without major capital expenditure.","ip":"company_owns_uni_academic_use","exclusivity":{"field":"all findings and reports","months":12},"publication":{"reviewDays":60,"companyMayRemoveConfidential":true},"backgroundIp":["Researcher's existing lipid oxidation methods and analytical protocols remain with researcher"],"contributions":{"company":["Oil samples across multiple batches and bottling dates","Access to bottling line for headspace oxygen sampling","Routine sample preparation support from in-house lab technician (Vesna Marković)","Funding via agreed contract"],"university":["Rancimat, HPLC-FLD, GC-FID, UV/Vis instrumentation","Expert analysis and interpretation of oxidation pathways","Written process improvement recommendations"]},"money":"to be agreed","timeline":{"months":9,"milestones":["M1 month 2: initial fatty acid profile and tocopherol baseline report","M2 month 5: oxidation kinetics and headspace oxygen assessment","M3 month 9: final report with ranked pathway findings and process recommendations"]},"contact":{"company":"Quality/Lab Manager, Zlatna Njiva d.o.o.","university":"Full Professor, Department of Applied and Engineering Chemistry"}},"reason":"University academic use rights are essential to allow publication of results, which is required for doctoral and research output obligations [R0231 open_to]; company_owns_uni_academic_use provides the company commercial protection while preserving the researcher's ability to publish findings after the exclusivity window [SYN-PUB-02918].","citations":["R0231 open_to","SYN-PUB-02918"]}
